_comment: Spell NAMES (as they appear in mythicsim-forever-engine/data/spells.jsonl) that Forte_Hunter tracks; resolved family-scoped (Family=9, verified via signature spells: Rapid Fire/Feign Death/Aspect of the Wild -> 9) with the CD-carrier rank pick + companion-shadow rule + uncoded-family fallback (see tools/gen_spell_data.py docstring). Selection policy: cooldowns = castable spells whose CooldownMs/CategoryCooldownMs >= 2990 (ForteXorcist 2.99 s floor); buffs = DurationMs > 0 with no cooldown (DoTs, mark/control windows, proc windows); aspects = permanent-aura (DurationMs=-1) toggles incl. Trueshot Aura; traps = thrown trap spells (shared 30 s trap category); pet_and_utility = Feign Death, pet heals/revive, pet control CDs, hunter pet-handling tools. Re-added 2026-11-01 via the uncoded-family fallback (their rows carry Family 0/absent in this build; generator prints '<name> -> <id> (uncoded fallback)'): Black Arrow (14296, DoT -> buffs), Eagle Eye (6197), Scare Beast (14327), Tame Beast (1515), Call Pet (883), Dismiss Pet (2641), Feed Pet (6991). Dive (pet dive, rows 23145-23150 also unflagged, resolves via the same fallback) stays OUT: not requested, and its 30 s category 44 is the shared pet-dive CD. Names still NOT listable: (a) rows with no row at all in this build -- Quick Shot; (b) names whose every in-family row is a bare companion shadowing the cast/proc row and have no uncoded twin -- Rapid Killing, Lock and Load, Focus Fire, Cobra Strikes, Frenzy, Hit and Run, Expose Weakness, Backdraft-style procs, Aspect-of-the-Viper companion 415718 (lv None beats lv 1: 415423 kept), Volley channel 14295 (shadowed by lv-58 damage twin 1279715). Re-check after each mythicsim-forever-engine pull; run with --dry first. Forever renames observed: Concussion Shot -> Concussive Shot, Wyvern Sting -> Wyvern Strike, Raptor Strike family new melee-range shot, Mongoose Bite shares attack-speed category 65 with Quick Shot. Notable Forever-new hunter spells: Sniper Shot (MM signature), Chimera Shot, Steady Shot (GCD filler, untracked), Kill Shot, Raptor Strike, Wyvern Strike, Enchanted Flare (Flare lv-32 twin), Flanking Strike, Trick Shots, Rapid Recuperation, Heart of the Lion, Dismember/Strider Kick/Dust Cloud/Growl (new pet family), Mine! (mechanical pet), Aspect of the Falcon, Aspect of the Viper, Trueshot Aura.
